name: World Bank World Development Indicators — countries, 1990–2024
description: Real World Bank indicators for 217 economies (countries and territories), one row per country and year from 1990 to 2024: population, GDP, growth, inflation, unemployment, life expectancy, infant mortality, fertility, urbanisation, internet use, electricity access, renewable energy, CO2 per person and health spending.
licence_note: CC BY 4.0. World Bank (2026), World Development Indicators, accessed through the World Bank API on 18 October 2026 (indicators last updated 8 October 2026). Aggregates (World, regions, income groups) were dropped; values rounded half-up to 6 decimals; missing values kept as NULL.
empty_message: No matching countries or years were found for these filters. Countries are filtered by ISO3 code (e.g. IND, CHN, USA).

total_population.label: Population
total_population.description: Total population (people); sum over the selected countries (missing values are skipped, so totals can be incomplete)

total_gdp_usd.label: GDP (current US$)
total_gdp_usd.description: Gross domestic product in current US dollars; sum over the selected countries (missing values are skipped, so totals can be incomplete)

gdp_per_capita_usd.label: GDP per capita (current US$)
gdp_per_capita_usd.description: GDP per person in current US dollars. For one country and year this is the World Bank value; for several countries it is the UNWEIGHTED mean of country values (not population-weighted); missing values are skipped

gdp_growth_pct.label: GDP growth (annual %)
gdp_growth_pct.description: Real GDP growth rate, percent per year. For one country and year this is the World Bank value; for several countries it is the UNWEIGHTED mean of country values (not population-weighted); missing values are skipped

inflation_pct.label: Inflation, consumer prices (annual %)
inflation_pct.description: Consumer price inflation, percent per year. For one country and year this is the World Bank value; for several countries it is the UNWEIGHTED mean of country values (not population-weighted); missing values are skipped

unemployment_pct.label: Unemployment (% of labour force)
unemployment_pct.description: Unemployment rate, ILO modelled estimate. For one country and year this is the World Bank value; for several countries it is the UNWEIGHTED mean of country values (not population-weighted); missing values are skipped

life_expectancy_years.label: Life expectancy at birth (years)
life_expectancy_years.description: Life expectancy at birth in years. For one country and year this is the World Bank value; for several countries it is the UNWEIGHTED mean of country values (not population-weighted); missing values are skipped

infant_mortality_per_1000.label: Infant mortality (per 1,000 live births)
infant_mortality_per_1000.description: Infant deaths per 1,000 live births. For one country and year this is the World Bank value; for several countries it is the UNWEIGHTED mean of country values (not population-weighted); missing values are skipped

fertility_rate.label: Fertility rate (births per woman)
fertility_rate.description: Births per woman. For one country and year this is the World Bank value; for several countries it is the UNWEIGHTED mean of country values (not population-weighted); missing values are skipped

urban_population_pct.label: Urban population (% of total)
urban_population_pct.description: Share of people living in urban areas. For one country and year this is the World Bank value; for several countries it is the UNWEIGHTED mean of country values (not population-weighted); missing values are skipped

internet_users_pct.label: Internet users (% of population)
internet_users_pct.description: Share of people using the internet. For one country and year this is the World Bank value; for several countries it is the UNWEIGHTED mean of country values (not population-weighted); missing values are skipped

electricity_access_pct.label: Access to electricity (% of population)
electricity_access_pct.description: Share of people with access to electricity. For one country and year this is the World Bank value; for several countries it is the UNWEIGHTED mean of country values (not population-weighted); missing values are skipped

renewable_energy_pct.label: Renewable energy (% of final energy use)
renewable_energy_pct.description: Renewable share of total final energy consumption. For one country and year this is the World Bank value; for several countries it is the UNWEIGHTED mean of country values (not population-weighted); missing values are skipped

co2_per_capita_tonnes.label: CO2 emissions per person (tonnes)
co2_per_capita_tonnes.description: CO2 emissions excluding land use, tonnes per person. For one country and year this is the World Bank value; for several countries it is the UNWEIGHTED mean of country values (not population-weighted); missing values are skipped

health_spending_pct_gdp.label: Health spending (% of GDP)
health_spending_pct_gdp.description: Current health expenditure as a share of GDP. For one country and year this is the World Bank value; for several countries it is the UNWEIGHTED mean of country values (not population-weighted); missing values are skipped

country.description: Country name in uppercase. Group by country ONLY for per-country lists or rankings (top/bottom N, each country). To FILTER a named country use country_code

region.description: World Bank region, uppercase. Values: EAST ASIA & PACIFIC; EUROPE & CENTRAL ASIA; LATIN AMERICA & CARIBBEAN; MIDDLE EAST, NORTH AFRICA, AFGHANISTAN & PAKISTAN; NORTH AMERICA; SOUTH ASIA; SUB-SAHARAN AFRICA

income_group.description: World Bank income group, uppercase. Values: HIGH INCOME; UPPER MIDDLE INCOME; LOWER MIDDLE INCOME; LOW INCOME

country_code.description: ISO 3166 alpha-3 code, uppercase (India=IND). Use ONLY for countries the question explicitly names; never add countries the question does not name. Rankings over all countries have no country_code filter

planning_notes: Rows are country-years. An average or total 'across' or 'of' the countries in a region, income group or the world is ONE value: dimensions=[] and a filter on that region/group. A change 'from year A to year B' is a compare: filters (target) contain year eq B ONLY, reference_filters (baseline) contain year eq A ONLY, and any country/region filter is copied into BOTH lists; never put both years in one list. Always filter a year (year eq YYYY) unless the question asks about a span of years or a trend by year; if a ranking or country value names no year, use needs_clarification. Filter a named country ONLY with country_code (ISO3, e.g. India=IND), never with country. Regions and income groups use the uppercase values listed. Totals of people or money use total_population / total_gdp_usd; per-person, percentage and rate indicators use their average metric. 'Top N countries by X' groups by country, sorts X desc and sets limit N. Never invent indicators that are not in the catalog (no literacy, trade, education, poverty, or sub-national data).
limitations: World Bank estimates; recent years are often missing for some countries and indicators, and values may be revised in later releases.
Averages over several countries are unweighted means of country values, not population-weighted; totals skip countries with missing values.
Regional and income-group results are computed from the countries in this table, not the World Bank's own published aggregates.
Only the listed indicators are loaded; no sub-national, monthly or forecast data.
Multi-step support is bounded to two scalar scopes, subset shares, and groups above the row-weighted population average; arbitrary chains and conversational follow-ups are unsupported.
